facts.fact: 十三岁时 Miri 陷入对性病的执念，把自己关进一个此后整个青春期都想逃出的“锁箱”。
facts.anchor: At the age of thirteen I became obsessed with venereal diseases

facts.fact: 与 Leah 的性被她比作钥匙与锁，打开了一扇她原以为不可通过的门。
facts.anchor: Sex with Leah was a key and a lock

facts.fact: Leah 出发前的最后一夜，Miri 把她按进床垫、按住又松开她的喉咙。
facts.anchor: I pushed her into the mattress and held her there

facts.fact: Carmen 视力有了好消息，可能符合一项旨在逆转退化的实验性手术条件。
facts.anchor: might be eligible for experimental surgery that will aim to reverse the degeneration

facts.fact: 回到家中，Miri 一度确信 Leah 已经消失，逐屋翻衣柜、翻抽屉。
facts.anchor: I become briefly convinced that Leah has vanished

facts.fact: 治疗师问 Miri 是否真正花时间想过妻子到底经历了什么。
facts.anchor: whether you have properly taken the time to imagine what it is your wife has been through

facts.fact: Miri 把纸条夹进最厚一本书的末页与封底之间再合上，以此演示她想象的“被压在海下”。
facts.anchor: The slip of paper sticks out between the final page and back cover like a bookmark

facts.fact: 回程公交上 Leah 上顶层时险些失足，说手指突然失去知觉。
facts.anchor: Leah nearly loses her footing climbing up to the top deck
